verdict.process_name: EF-210 epoxy floor coating, Part A
verdict.instruction: Flush each 20 kg pail with nitrogen (approx. 0.06 m³ per pail) before filling.
verdict.reason: The step was introduced to prevent carbamation of amine hardeners (E3). However, EF-210 Part A is the product being filled (E1, E4), and amine hardeners were moved to a different line (FL-3) in 2017 (E4). It is undocumented whether EF-210 Part A itself is susceptible to carbamation or requires nitrogen flushing.
